description.text: In a concrete road tunnel under overhead sodium strip lights, the

waits deep in shadow at the far end, its carbon-fibre body almost lost against the unlit concrete. The car rolls forward into the lit roadway; the darkness recedes behind it as the strip lights catch along its low nose, wide stance, and dark bodywork. The lit concrete recedes in depth behind the car, keeping the tunnel walls and ceiling readable while the vehicle becomes clearly visible in the foreground. Reflections slide across the body panels, and the strip lights pick out the edges of the carbon-fibre surfaces as the car moves from near-invisible shadow into the pool of sodium light.
At the tunnel's far end, the
begins to move, its shape still sunk in shadow; the first strip-light reflections appear along its roofline and nose as it eases forward.
A low engine rumble and tyres rolling on concrete, with a faint tunnel echo, are added as creative sound design.

crosses into the lit concrete, the sodium strip lights now raking across its carbon-fibre body; the previously shadowed front end becomes crisp and reflective, while the dark tunnel recedes behind it.
settles into the lit roadway, its bodywork fully revealed against the concrete; the sodium strips throw a hard sheen across the carbon-fibre panels as the tunnel darkness remains behind it.
